kv18.5:2.7: Nanu tiṇṇam saññojanānaṃ pahānaṃ sotāpattiphalaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā ti?

kv18.5:6.3: Sāvakā Buddhassa Bhagavato adiṭṭhaṃ dakkhinti, anadhigataṃ adhigacchanti, asacchikataṃ sacchikarontīti?
